verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Letta documents automations, including scheduled tasks on a recurring schedule, headless CI use and mods. However, nothing in the pack shows these automations can be versioned, reviewed as diffs, or rolled back. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct: MemFS commits memory updates, shared memory repositories are Git-backed, and /fork branches conversations. None of these is versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
